searchText: **EIPIP Meeting 47** I didn't see much conversation in the EIP editors channels on ECH or Eth R&D. So, we have very light agenda - https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/101 . Feel free to drop in items to be discussed, if you have any. Let me know if people think it make sense to cancel this week's EIPIP meeting and we can have it scheduled for the next planned date (Jan 12th).
